categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific details about land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, ownership details, property boundaries, and servitude rights. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The Commissioner of Title Settlement is acting in an administrative capacity related to land registration, not making government personnel or structural announcements.
